children: The medium- to long-term outlook for U.S. AI data centers likely involves builders offering more safeguards, local investments, and contractual commitments including electricity-bill protection, says Malik Ahmed Khan, senior equity analyst from Morningstar. Anthropic, with its focus on building AI for humanity and its high-profile spat with the DoW, may benefit from increased AI regulation under Democrats. The analyst doesn't expect any near-term impact on Anthropic's IPO, but says the dynamic warrants monitoring the next couple of years. (jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
